days.title: Glacial Peaks and Base Huts
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kverkjökull
stops.detail: In this gap, the valley glacier Kverkjökull flows northwest down to the 900 m high plateau in front of the mountains.

stops.name: Sigurðarskáli
stops.detail: The relatively comfortable Sigurðarskáli hut of the Fljotsdalsherad and Husavik Touring Clubs is located at the foot of the Kverkfjöll at an altitude of approx. 900 m ().

days.title: Calderas and High Altitude Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Gengissig
stops.detail: The northern caldera is named Gengissig and is located slightly southeast of the glacier association hut (Jöklarannsóknarfélag), the other caldera is named Galtarlón and is located in the Efri Hveradalur.

stops.name: Galtarlón
stops.detail: Inside the Hveradalir is the lake Galtarlón in a small caldera.

days.title: Geothermal Valleys and Fumaroles
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hveradalir
stops.detail: There lies a narrow valley that extends into the western mountain range, the Hveradalir, to which a strenuous glacier hike leads up.

stops.name: Gámur
stops.detail: There also lies Gámur, a large fumarole.

stops.name: Hveragil
stops.detail: Vegetation is found mainly around the hot springs in the Hveragil.
